Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Biostatistics Gianluca Guidi earned his PhD cum laude in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Pisa as part of the Italian National Doctorate. His work explores how AI systems and digital infrastructure shape energy use, climate change, water resources, and environmental and public health. Through data science and machine learning, his work aims to support more sustainable and equitable technology and climate policy. The environmental burden of the United States' bitcoin mining boom. Guidi G, Dominici F, Steinsultz N, Dance G, Henneman L, Richardson H, Castro E, Bargagli-Stoffi FJ, Delaney S. Nat Commun 2025 Mar 26 PMID: 40140387
